+
+# Homebrew Tap
+
+`wstein/homebrew-tap` hosts the Homebrew formula used to install `@wsmy/cx-cli`.
+This tap is updated from tagged releases in this repository. The formula is generated from the published npm tarball and installed with Homebrew's Node integration.
+
+## Links
+
+- `scripts/generate-homebrew-formula.ts`
+- `.github/workflows/publish-homebrew.yml`
+- `README.md`
+- `package.json`

+# Repomix CX Fork
+
+`https://github.com/wstein/repomix-cx-fork` is the federated Repomix adapter used by this repo.

+---
+id: 20260416093011

+tags: ["distribution","npm","homebrew"]
+---
+
+# npm Package Tarball
+
+`https://registry.npmjs.org/@wsmy/cx-cli/-/cx-cli-X.Y.Z.tgz` is the immutable npm tarball URL used by the Homebrew formula.
+The CI workflow computes its SHA-256 checksum from the published tarball before writing the formula, ensuring Homebrew installs the exact released package.
+
+## Links
+
+- `scripts/generate-homebrew-formula.ts`
+- `.github/workflows/publish-homebrew.yml`
+- `package.json`
